caption:
I literally froze when I read the final message from this client😶 

They approved the entire video without a single revision.

I always expect to do at least a few rounds of intense tweaks.

My initial shock turned into massive hype when the video actually exploded on their page.

The honest truth is that the client made this a total breeze.

Their energy on camera and the script were absolute fire.

Having incredible raw footage is the ultimate W strategy for any editor.

Every time I looped their clips a new creative idea just clicked.

It never felt like a stressful grind because the foundation was perfect.

If you had to name exactly one thing you love about this edit what is it?
